features.identified: Mirage roadside marquee and small adjoining shelter
features.observed: Broad white marquee cap, pair of white piers, dark display and cream vertical trim, little pale roof shelter to south. Aerial inspected, street view/height and current scene ownership pending. Retain historic Mirage baseline rather than infer new Hard Rock construction.

sources.review: Side-on white structural pylon with projecting cap; shelter has white/bronze fascia and square columns. Construction visible in2025 so historical view selected.

sources.author: Julian Hoffbauer
sources.review: Nighttime north face: two tall white legs, two stacked feature panels, projecting cap with THE MIRAGE and CASINO & RESORT.
UNLV Neon Survey corroborates double-post pylon, inset metallic strips and stacked display cabinets. No reliable height stated.
Corroborates placement south of lagoon/north of Forum Shops;184ft dimension in article belongs to FRONTIER, not Mirage.

estimates.basis: Approximation from mapped25m cap width, broad-face photo proportions and side-view elevation; no survey height verified.
